description.value: The Parkside Brewery is a craft brewery and tasting room on Port Moody's celebrated 'Brewer's Row,' situated directly across from Rocky Point Park at the eastern end of Burrard Inlet. The brewery produces award-winning beers across a wide range of styles, from easy-drinking lagers to bold hoppy ales, all brewed on-site by head brewer Vern Lambourne. Its location near waterfront trails, forested parklands, and the broader Burrard Inlet cycling network makes it a natural and rewarding stop for touring cyclists.
